steps.npc: Good to see you again [player name]. Have you come to marvel at the beauty of Prifddinas?

steps.player: It's definitely a sight to behold.

steps.npc: Indeed it is. I love exploring, seeking out the hidden secrets of this world. But nothing will ever compare to this place, to our home.

steps.player: I'm very privileged to be able to see it.

steps.npc: And we are very privileged to have you here.
